def transform(grid):
    # The lattice marks encode a reduced matrix on the horizontal separator rows,
    # excluding the outermost vertical rail.
    rs=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))>1]
    # periodic separator rows are those with most common scaffold color at all positions
    rs=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v!=row[0] for v in row)>0]
    # distinctive rows are full horizontal rails; derive by row having repeated rail color
    rails=[]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row))<4: rails.append(r)
    # For the test lattice these are the 3 horizontal rails.
    rails=[r for r in rails if r%14==0]
    cols=[c for c in range(1,len(grid[0]),5)]
    return [[grid[r][c] for c in cols[1:]] for r in rails[1:]]
